en: Colorized historic street view showing a European town square with cobblestone streets. A tall clock tower stands in the center background, flanked by multi‑story townhouses and a prominent school building labeled with German text. A horse-drawn cart moves along the street, and a few pedestrians are visible. At the top of the image the captions read "Elbogen." on the left and "K. K. Staats-Realschule." on the right.
